name: EPIC 249837084
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 11.3 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,748 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.93 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,780 K at its surface.
